summary: Medication Reminder Dashboard - full E2E test PASSED. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (list-empty, create success + persistence GET, validation 422 for empty name / empty times / empty days / missing device_id, update + not-found, toggle-taken mark + persist + untake + not-found, delete + delete-not-found). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport 375x667 verified end-to-end: (1) Planner tab renders 'My Planner' with big purple 'Medications' card at top and subtitle 'Tap to view today's reminders'; (2) tapping card navigates to /medications; (3) both empty states render simultaneously ('Nothing scheduled today' + 'No medications yet'); (4) FAB (+ button, 64x64 at bottom-right) opens modal with title 'Add Medication'; (5) Form validation - saving with empty name shows inline error box 'Please enter the medication name.', saving after filling name but with no times selected shows 'Please pick at least one reminder time.'; (6) Created 'TEST_Metformin' 500 mg with 8:00 AM + 8:00 PM chips, notes 'Take with food', default all-7-days, default color; med appears in All Medications AND in Today's Schedule sorted by time (8:00 AM appears before 8:00 PM in DOM), progress card shows '0 of 2 doses taken today'; (7) Tapping 'Take' on first dose flips to 'Taken' state and progress becomes '1 of 2 doses taken today'; (8) After full page reload, progress still shows '1 of 2 doses taken today' and Taken state persists (server-backed by device_id + date); (9) Tapping 'Taken' toggles back to 'Take' and progress reverts to '0 of 2'; (10) Edit flow works - opens 'Edit Medication' modal pre-populated, 'Save Changes' updates list (renamed to TEST_Renamed, 250 mg); (11) Delete flow - Web window.confirm dialog fires with correct message, on accept the medication is removed from both Today's Schedule and All Medications and empty states return; (12) Back button (top-left, arrow-back icon) returns to Planner root (/); (13) Planner regression - Day/Week/Month toggles all render correctly with the Medications card still visible at the top of every view; no red-screen errors during any flow. No blocking bugs found. One minor navigation robustness concern: when /medications is opened directly (deep link, no history), router.back() logs 'GO_BACK not handled by any navigator' and Back becomes a no-op - not user-visible on normal Planner->Medications flow but would strand a user who deep-links.

issues: No testID props on interactive elements (FAB, Back button, Take/Taken toggles, Edit/Delete buttons, time chips, day chips, color swatches, form inputs, Save/Cancel). Tests had to fall back to text-based selectors which pick up duplicate matches (e.g. 'Add Medication' matches both the modal title AND the primary button in the modal - required .nth(1) workaround). Recommend adding testIDs: meds-fab, meds-back-btn, meds-name-input, meds-dosage-input, meds-notes-input, meds-time-chip-<time>, meds-day-chip-<idx>, meds-color-swatch-<hex>, meds-save-btn, meds-cancel-btn, meds-edit-btn-<id>, meds-delete-btn-<id>, meds-take-btn-<id>-<time>, meds-progress-text, meds-error-box.
Planner (tabs)/index.tsx medsCard also lacks a testID (e.g. planner-meds-card) - fine visually but fragile for future automation.
Deprecated inline shadow* style props on medsCard + fab produce React Native web warnings ('shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'). Not blocking but should migrate.

react_native_issues.issue: router.back() at medications.tsx:446 fails with console error 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' when the /medications route is opened directly (deep link / page reload). Result: Back button becomes a no-op. Recommend using router.canGoBack() check and falling back to router.replace('/') so Back always lands the user on the Planner tab. Reference: /app/frontend/app/medications.tsx:446.

shadow* style props deprecation warning from react-native-web on medsCard/fab shadows - use boxShadow instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (medsCard, fab), /app/frontend/app/medications.tsx (fab).

action_items: (Low priority) Add testID props to medications.tsx and index.tsx medsCard for stable UI automation (list in design_issues).
(Medium priority) Fix router.back() no-op on direct /medications page load - wrap with `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/')` in medications.tsx:446 so Back always works.
(Low priority) Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow / individual shadow properties per react-native-web guidance.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py medications endpoints: excludes _id via projection {'_id':0} on both GET queries and pops _id after POST insert - clean. Pydantic min_length validators enforce non-empty name/times/days at API boundary (frontend inline checks are defense-in-depth).
Toggle-taken uses (medication_id, date, time) tuple, storing device_id for scoping - correct design; deleting a medication also cleans up its medication_taken rows.

medications.tsx uses SafeAreaView, KeyboardAvoidingView, ScrollView with keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled', 48-56px min touch targets, high-contrast error box, big FAB, big time/day/color chips - matches senior-friendly design. Good.
medications.tsx#loadMeds callback correctly re-runs when todayStr changes and reloads after save/toggle-error - state stays consistent.
server.py uses @app.on_event('startup') for index creation - deprecated in FastAPI, should migrate to lifespan handlers (same as previous iteration; still not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Created temporary meds under fresh device_ids: 'TEST_Metformin', 'TEST_EditMe'/'TEST_Renamed', 'TEST_DeleteMe'. All test-created meds + medication_taken rows cleaned up post-run via MongoDB delete (meds deleted: 2, taken deleted: 0). No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App URL: https://easy-productivity-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Medications feature fully functional. Device ID is generated per browser context via AsyncStorage key 'device_id' - each fresh Playwright context starts with a new device (empty state). Web deletion uses window.confirm - use page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) to auto-accept; after that the delete API call may hang the current click promise, so wait 3s and re-check DOM rather than awaiting the click completion. FAB in mobile viewport 375x667 sits at approx (323, 611) - locator by icon is hard because Ionicons render as SVG without labels, so page.mouse.click(323, 611) works. 'Add Medication' text matches both modal title AND save button - use .nth(1) for the button. Known non-blocking: router.back() fails on direct /medications load; Weather widget fetch fails on preview URL (unrelated to this feature).
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs blocking the feature. Only minor UX/hygiene items in action_items (Back button no-op on deep-link, missing testIDs, deprecated shadow props).
